historical_reviews.deepseek: Cannot prove OCP module coverage, LCRC direction or service preservation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Improves installation safety but generic link health does not show direction-specific replay or independent OCP coverage.
historical_reviews.related_cases: PCIe row 61 uses identical tuple/commands. This variant requires a physical OCP module/interface/service mapping and must not count the same target twice.
historical_reviews.v3_1: OCP link testing needs independent management, directed disposable traffic and interface/service recovery in addition to link counters.

original_test_intent: Verify correctable LCRC handling in transmit and receive directions for every required OCP slot, demonstrating directional replay/counter evidence while preserving the OCP interface and its dependent services.
original_method: Inventory each OCP module, firmware, driver, interface, service dependency and PCIe-to-NBIO/core/port path; prove errortype direction semantics and identify observer; establish independent OOB management; run disposable bidirectional traffic; baseline link/AER/NIC counters; inject TX and RX separately; correlate directional status and packet outcome; verify no fatal escalation, link downgrade or service loss; restore BIOS/HDT/AER state.
manual_activity: The FAE maps the OCP module and its dependencies, approves directional semantics and disposable traffic, performs separate TX/RX injections under independent OOB supervision and owns interface/service recovery.
required_inputs: OCP slot/module serial/FW/driver/interface/BDF to socket/die/NBIO/core/port map for all targets
Distinct coverage versus PCIe row 61 and management/storage/fabric service dependencies
Vendor proof errortype 0/1 means LCRC TX/RX and which endpoint observes each error
Disposable bidirectional traffic and direction-specific link/AER/NIC counter plus packet oracle
Decoded 7EF6030 relevance, masks, DPC and SyncFlood policy for correctable LCRC
Supported OS, timeout, replay/retrain thresholds, aborts, independent OOB recovery and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated OCP path with OOB management independent of the tested interface and no production traffic
Power/ESD-safe module handling and live path verification; do not copy the PCIe companion tuple
Baseline service health and counters under controlled directional traffic before one stimulus
Abort on wrong interface/counter, service loss, link downgrade, excessive loss, driver reset or fatal escalation
No automatic retry; preserve evidence and restore/diff BIOS/HDT/AER/SyncFlood and module state
agent_execution_scope: Validate OCP identity, dependencies, direction semantics, traffic, counters and correctable oracle
Collect read-only link/AER/NIC counters, packet integrity, interface/service, OS/BMC and post-health evidence
Do not install hardware, choose tuple/traffic/threshold, alter BIOS/HDT, inject/retrain/reset/retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve OCP-to-NBIO mapping and distinct coverage
Approve TX/RX semantics, traffic and thresholds
Supervise separate stimuli and interface/service recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A broad log grep cannot identify the OCP module, LCRC direction, link replay or affected service and mixes unrelated PCIe error classes.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After live OCP mapping and flag approval, inject TX and RX separately during isolated traffic and correlate per-direction counter/status deltas with packet, interface and service health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Tuple 0:0:1/core3/port0, errortype 0/1, correctable Criteria, OCP slot 1~N, severity/SyncFlood settings and 30/60-minute values remain preserved but gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Exercise separate TX/RX LCRC faults on a mapped OCP module under disposable traffic, proving directional replay and restored interface/service health without link degradation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds module/service identity, independent OOB path, directed traffic, counter thresholds, distinct coverage and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The same tuple and generic logs as the PCIe case cannot prove any OCP slot or service was independently exercised.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A link fault may interrupt management, storage or fabric traffic, retrain/downgrade the link, reset the driver or destabilize the host.

project_override_considerations: If the OCP module is the sole management or cluster-control path, retain execution as pending until an independent channel and traffic-isolation plan exist. Lack of directional counters requires an approved analyzer, not a generic dmesg substitute.
expected_evidence: Exact OCP module/interface/service and NBIO/core/port identity
Approved errortype direction map, decoded policy and baseline directional counters
Disposable traffic endpoints/direction with packet/checksum baseline
Separate TX/RX transcripts and attributable replay/status/counter deltas
No fatal escalation, link downgrade or persistent interface/service impact

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: OCP slot 1~N uses the same fixed tuple as PCIe row 61 with no module/interface/service or distinct-coverage map. TX/RX flags lack authority, ECC RDIMM is unexplained, logs mix unrelated errors, and no directed traffic/counter oracle exists. Correctable Criteria coexist with undecoded uncorrectable severity/SyncFlood controls; timeout is undefined and RHEL 2022 ambiguous.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Directional OCP LCRC intent is clear. Static review completes while execution waits for identity, service isolation and counter authority.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 62 Wistron-System RAS-00782-V002: provide OCP slot/module/FW/driver/interface-to-NBIO/core/port coverage and distinct scope versus PCIe row 61; prove errortype 0/1 TX/RX observing semantics and justify ECC RDIMM; define isolated bidirectional traffic, direction-specific counters, packet/replay/retrain and interface/service thresholds; approve 7EF6030/masks/DPC/SyncFlood relevance, supported OS, timeout, aborts, independent OOB recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Makes the OCP variant independently traceable through module, interface and service evidence and replaces generic logs with directional replay and traffic-integrity acceptance.
independent_technical_reasoning: An OCP NIC may be the host's management or fabric path, so corrected link replay still needs a service-impact boundary. The receiving side detects LCRC, meaning TX/RX labels must be tied to link roles and traffic direction. Identical tuple/commands across PCIe and OCP rows are not separate coverage unless physical identity and observed interface counters prove different targets.
